summary: BitFuFu Inc. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) announcing September 2026 Bitcoin production data, including a status update on its proposed acquisition of a majority stake in an Ethiopian company operating an 80 MW Bitcoin mining facility. The deal, originally disclosed October 22, 2024, is structured via wholly-owned subsidiary Finfront Holding Company acquiring shares from the Sellers. Closing conditions include asset consolidation, required Ethiopian government filings, and absence of material adverse change; conditions precedent remain unsatisfied as of the filing date. No price, premium, or closing timetable was disclosed. Watch for condition satisfaction or potential termination.
